### Findings / interpretations recorded

- **P34.18 leftover repaired fix-forward (recorded, not hidden):**
  `tests/unit/test_p34_18_aliases.py::test_rekey_is_idempotent_and_clean`
  failed locally on this branch **and on the clean base** — the whole-tree
  rekey sweep wanted to rewrite `policy/src/policy/source_aliases.py`,
  whose docstring still carried the retired personal token (the OKCPD
  chief's former handle + the bare surname — never re-spelled in tracked
  files; the plaintext lives only in the restricted map, lines 158–159).
  The failure only surfaces
  on a machine holding the gitignored
  `docs/build/logs/p34.18/restricted_source_map.json` (CI never has it —
  P34.18's boundary at `75ac83d` was green honestly). The docstring now
  uses the sweep's own neutral form (`the OKCPD chief` / `the chief`);
  a tracked-file `git grep` for the retired token = 0 hits; the rekey test + the full
  policy suite pass. Two-line fix-forward on this branch, consistent with
  P34.18's "zero handle entries in tracked files" invariant.
- **AC1 "no research-queue link" — scoped to the empty-state remedy.** The
  five-part states carry no queue CTA (asserted on every
  `empty-state-cta` href). The one remaining `research-queue` string on
  the built pages is the shared nav chrome in `BaseLayout` — sitewide,
  not an empty-state action, present on non-empty pages too; removing it
  is not this ticket's scope (K7 WX-07 is about the remedy CTA).
- **Composed-test assertion hardened:** an early assertion compared the
  upstream-link label against raw HTML — the apostrophe renders as
  `&#39;`. The test now asserts the `data-testid` + the unescaped
  substring `own link (recorded as a claim)`; the rendered text is
  unchanged (the escape is correct HTML).
- **Artifact counts derived, never pinned (OM-15):** the composed test
  reads `len(evidence.json["artifacts"])` and `synthetic` count from the
  export bytes the build consumed (`_WebBuild.export_dir`), then asserts
  listed rows == artifacts and run-record labels == synthetic rows.
- **`SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL` (AC4):** the flag only injects `web/src/internal/`
  pages; it does not change `dataSource()`. `getCaptureDiff()` keys on
  `dataSource() === "export"`, so an export build (with or without the
  flag) can never render the fixture diff — the sweep asserts the fixture
  capture ids and claim-view routes are absent.
- **Post-closeout boundary red → fixed forward (recorded):** the
  closeout head `1ee43be5` read `blockedOn` on `docs` — the appended
  PHASE LOG entry was 2,160 B, over the 2 KiB BM-LEDGER-06 budget for
  current-region entries (the guard's warning list only flagged OLDER
  regions, so the violation surfaced at the CI range check, not the
  local `--staged` pass — the staged run's 80 evaluated items skipped
  the ledger-budget rule). The entry was trimmed to 1,965 B preserving
  every recorded field; `check-build-memory` clean. Repair commit
  follows this record.
- **Copy batch:** 27 new EW-01…EW-27 rows appended to `batch-02.md`
  (pending, sha256-verified spot-checks EW-01/19/25/26 OK);
  `ops/publish.py#check_publishable_copy` now scans **every**
  `batch-*.md`, not just batch-01, so a pending batch-02 row refuses
  `--apply` instead of misreporting `untracked`.
